    tStateStepTimer                 : TON;
    tPressureStabilizeTimer         : TON;
    tThermalExpansionCalibTimer     : TON;
    tQuenchRecoveryTimer            : TON;
    tDepressurizeTimer              : TON;
    rRampTargetChoke_mm             : REAL := 0.0;
    rCurrentChokeRampRate_mms       : REAL := 0.05;
    rRampTargetFlashBypass_pct      : REAL := 100.0;
    rRampTargetGov_pct              : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Iteration & Matrix Arithmetic Index Variables *)
    i                               : INT  := 1;
    j                               : INT  := 1;
    k_idx                           : INT  := 1;

    (* Physical, Material & Metallurgical Constants *)
    c_rAlphaCeramic_perK            : REAL := 3.2E-6;   (* Si3N4 Silicon Nitride ceramic linear CTE [1/K] *)
    c_rAlphaStem_perK               : REAL := 13.8E-6;  (* Inconel 718 actuator drive spindle CTE [1/K] *)
    c_rAlphaCage_perK               : REAL := 12.8E-6;  (* Hastelloy C-276 containment cage CTE [1/K] *)
    c_rL0_Stem_mm                   : REAL := 2400.0;   (* Nominal spindle stem length at reference temp [mm] *)
    c_rL0_Cage_mm                   : REAL := 2350.0;   (* Nominal outer structural cage length [mm] *)
    c_rL0_Ceramic_mm                : REAL := 250.0;    (* Nominal ceramic needle & seat assembly length [mm] *)
    c_rRefTemp_degC                 : REAL := 20.0;     (* Ambient reference calibration temperature [deg C] *)
    c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm            : REAL := 100.0;    (* Full physical travel of downhole choke actuator [mm] *)
    c_rMinChokeStroke_mm            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Fully seated choke position [mm] *)
    c_rCycleDt_s                    : REAL := 0.100;    (* Discrete PLC cyclic task execution interval (100 ms) [s] *)
    c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar           : REAL := 8.5;      (* Permissible inter-channel downhole pressure drift [bar] *)
    c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC          : REAL := 15.0;     (* Permissible inter-channel downhole temperature drift [deg C] *)
    c_rCritMaxPres_bar              : REAL := 340.0;    (* SIL-3 high-pressure casing structural safety trip [bar] *)
    c_rCritMaxTemp_degC             : REAL := 480.0;    (* SIL-3 high-temperature downhole metallurgical trip [deg C] *)
    c_rCritMaxAE_dB                 : REAL := 75.0;     (* Catastrophic fault slip acoustic emission trip [dB] *)
    c_rCritTurbineOverspeed_rpm     : REAL := 3960.0;   (* 110% turbine mechanical overspeed emergency trip [rpm] *)
    c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms             : REAL := 2.50;     (* Anti-water hammer choke velocity ceiling [mm/s] *)
    c_rMaxGovernorSlew_pcts         : REAL := 15.0;     (* Turbine governor electro-hydraulic valve max rate [%/s] *)
    c_rGasConstant_kJkgK            : REAL := 0.461526; (* Specific gas constant for pure steam H2O [kJ/(kg*K)] *)
    c_rCriticalTemp_degC            : REAL := 373.946;  (* Thermodynamic critical point temperature of H2O [deg C] *)
    c_rCriticalPres_bar             : REAL := 220.64;   (* Thermodynamic critical point pressure of H2O [bar] *)
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC LOGIC EXECUTION ARCHITECTURE (SAMPLE PERIOD Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    (* Immediate deterministic de-energization and safe-state commanding *)
    rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;   (* Close downhole ceramic choke immediately *)
    rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0; (* Full open surface bypass to dissipate steam pressure *)
    rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;   (* Trip turbine admission governor valve instantly *)
    rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 100.0; (* Open emergency atmospheric quench desuperheater *)
    rCmdBrineReinjection_pct    := 100.0; (* Divert full brine discharge to reinjection well *)
    bEmergencyDumpActive        := TRUE;
    bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
    bSystemReady                := FALSE;
    wFaultWord.0                := TRUE;  (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Tripped *)
    wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F001;
    iState                      := 999;   (* Jump immediately to Failsafe Emergency Depressurization *)
    iActiveState                := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical Turbine Overspeed Hardware Protection (110% = 3960 rpm) *)
IF (rTurbineSpeed_rpm >= c_rCritTurbineOverspeed_rpm) OR bTurbineTripInterlock THEN
    rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;   (* Immediate mechanical trip *)
    rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0; (* Fast-acting bypass dump accepts entire steam flow *)
    bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
    wFaultWord.1                := TRUE;  (* Bit 1: Turbine Overspeed / Protection Trip *)
    IF iState = 80 THEN
        iState := 60; (* Revert to Surface Flash Equilibration / Island Mode *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Critical Downhole Overpressure Interlock (P > 340 bar) *)
IF (rWellheadPress_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar) OR
   (bPresA_Valid AND (rDownholePressA_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar)) OR
   (bPresB_Valid AND (rDownholePressB_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar)) OR
   (bPresC_Valid AND (rDownholePressC_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar)) THEN
    rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;
    rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0;
    rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 100.0;
    bEmergencyDumpActive        := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.2                := TRUE;  (* Bit 2: Critical Overpressure Trip *)
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* Critical Downhole Over-Temperature Interlock (T > 480 deg C) *)
IF (bTempA_Valid AND (rDownholeTempA_degC > c_rCritMaxTemp_degC)) OR
   (bTempB_Valid AND (rDownholeTempB_degC > c_rCritMaxTemp_degC)) OR
   (bTempC_Valid AND (rDownholeTempC_degC > c_rCritMaxTemp_degC)) THEN
    wFaultWord.3                := TRUE;  (* Bit 3: Critical Over-Temperature Trip *)
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* Catastrophic Fault Slip Acoustic Emission Shock Burst (AE > 75 dB) *)
IF (rAcousticEmissionLevel_dB > c_rCritMaxAE_dB) THEN
    bSeismicTripLatch           := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.4                := TRUE;  (* Bit 4: Unstable Fault Slip Trip *)
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- Subsystem 2.1: Downhole Pressure Transducers (2oo3 Voting) --- *)
(* Sensor Physical Plausibility Range Verification (0.0 .. 400.0 bar) *)
bPresA_Valid := (rDownholePressA_bar >= 0.0) AND (rDownholePressA_bar <= 400.0);
bPresB_Valid := (rDownholePressB_bar >= 0.0) AND (rDownholePressB_bar <= 400.0);
bPresC_Valid := (rDownholePressC_bar >= 0.0) AND (rDownholePressC_bar <= 400.0);

rDiffPres_AB := ABS(rDownholePressA_bar - rDownholePressB_bar);
rDiffPres_BC := ABS(rDownholePressB_bar - rDownholePressC_bar);
rDiffPres_CA := ABS(rDownholePressC_bar - rDownholePressA_bar);

IF bPresA_Valid AND bPresB_Valid AND bPresC_Valid THEN
    IF (rDiffPres_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.1: Complete 3-Channel Consensus -> Classic Median Value Voting *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressB_bar + rDownholePressC_bar
                                   - MIN(rDownholePressA_bar, MIN(rDownholePressB_bar, rDownholePressC_bar))
                                   - MAX(rDownholePressA_bar, MAX(rDownholePressB_bar, rDownholePressC_bar));
        iHealthyPresCount       := 3;
        wDegradedModeWord.0     := FALSE; (* Channel A Healthy *)
        wDegradedModeWord.1     := FALSE; (* Channel B Healthy *)
        wDegradedModeWord.2     := FALSE; (* Channel C Healthy *)
        wFaultWord.5            := FALSE; (* No Pressure TMR Fault *)
    ELSIF (rDiffPres_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_AB > c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.2: Channel A Drifted -> Quarantine Channel A, Degrade to 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressB_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
        iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.0     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Ch A *)
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;  (* Pressure TMR Degraded Alarm *)
    ELSIF (rDiffPres_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_AB > c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.3: Channel B Drifted -> Quarantine Channel B, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
        iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.1     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Ch B *)
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffPres_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_BC > c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.4: Channel C Drifted -> Quarantine Channel C, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressB_bar) * 0.5;
        iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.2     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Ch C *)
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
    ELSE
        (* Case 2.1.5: Total Loss of Pressure Consensus -> Failsafe to Wellhead Pressure + Hydrostatic Gradient *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := rWellheadPress_bar + 185.0; (* Hydrostatic head approx for 4,800 m supercritical column *)
        iHealthyPresCount       := 0;
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
        wFaultWord.6            := TRUE;  (* Total Downhole Sensor Bank Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPresB_Valid AND bPresC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressB_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.0     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
ELSIF bPresA_Valid AND bPresC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.1     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
ELSIF bPresA_Valid AND bPresB_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressB_bar) * 0.5;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.2     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Complete sensor failure *)
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := rWellheadPress_bar + 185.0;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 0;
    wFaultWord.6            := TRUE;
    iState                  := 999;
END_IF;

(* --- Subsystem 2.2: Downhole Temperature Thermocouples (2oo3 Voting) --- *)
bTempA_Valid := (rDownholeTempA_degC >= 0.0) AND (rDownholeTempA_degC <= 550.0);
bTempB_Valid := (rDownholeTempB_degC >= 0.0) AND (rDownholeTempB_degC <= 550.0);
bTempC_Valid := (rDownholeTempC_degC >= 0.0) AND (rDownholeTempC_degC <= 550.0);

rDiffTemp_AB := ABS(rDownholeTempA_degC - rDownholeTempB_degC);
rDiffTemp_BC := ABS(rDownholeTempB_degC - rDownholeTempC_degC);
rDiffTemp_CA := ABS(rDownholeTempC_degC - rDownholeTempA_degC);

IF bTempA_Valid AND bTempB_Valid AND bTempC_Valid THEN
    IF (rDiffTemp_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC
                                   - MIN(rDownholeTempA_degC, MIN(rDownholeTempB_degC, rDownholeTempC_degC))
                                   - MAX(rDownholeTempA_degC, MAX(rDownholeTempB_degC, rDownholeTempC_degC));
        iHealthyTempCount       := 3;
        wDegradedModeWord.3     := FALSE;
        wDegradedModeWord.4     := FALSE;
        wDegradedModeWord.5     := FALSE;
        wFaultWord.7            := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDiffTemp_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_AB > c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.3     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Temp Ch A *)
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffTemp_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_AB > c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.4     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Temp Ch B *)
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffTemp_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_BC > c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC) * 0.5;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.5     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Temp Ch C *)
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) / 3.0;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 0;
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
        wFaultWord.8            := TRUE;  (* Total Downhole Temperature Consensus Lost *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTempB_Valid AND bTempC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
    iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.3     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempA_Valid AND bTempC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
    iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.4     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempA_Valid AND bTempB_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC) * 0.5;
    iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.5     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := 450.0; (* Safe fallback assumption *)
    iHealthyTempCount       := 0;
    wFaultWord.8            := TRUE;
    iState                  := 999;
END_IF;

bDegradedTMRActive := (iHealthyPresCount < 3) OR (iHealthyTempCount < 3);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: DYNAMIC CERAMIC CHOKE ACTUATOR THERMAL EXPANSION NULLING KINETICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Discrete 3-Node Thermal Capacitance & Conduction ODE Integration (Euler Forward, dt = 0.1s) *)
(* Node 1: Si3N4 Ceramic Trim exposed directly to supercritical fluid convective heat transfer *)
rTempNodeCeramic_degC := rTempNodeCeramic_degC + (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.1850 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - rTempNodeCeramic_degC))
                                               - (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0420 * (rTempNodeCeramic_degC - rTempNodeStem_degC));

(* Node 2: Inconel 718 Drive Spindle Stem heated by ceramic trim and cooled by casing conduction *)
rTempNodeStem_degC    := rTempNodeStem_degC    + (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0420 * (rTempNodeCeramic_degC - rTempNodeStem_degC))
                                               - (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0180 * (rTempNodeStem_degC - rTempNodeCage_degC));

(* Node 3: Hastelloy C-276 Outer Structural Cage immersed in wellbore annulus fluid *)
rTempNodeCage_degC    := rTempNodeCage_degC    + (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.1250 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - rTempNodeCage_degC))
                                               - (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0220 * (rTempNodeCage_degC - (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC * 0.88)));

(* Compute Component Thermal Elongations: Delta L = L0 * alpha * Delta T [mm] *)
rStemElongation_mm    := c_rL0_Stem_mm    * c_rAlphaStem_perK    * (rTempNodeStem_degC    - c_rRefTemp_degC);
rCageElongation_mm    := c_rL0_Cage_mm    * c_rAlphaCage_perK    * (rTempNodeCage_degC    - c_rRefTemp_degC);
rCeramicElongation_mm := c_rL0_Ceramic_mm * c_rAlphaCeramic_perK * (rTempNodeCeramic_degC - c_rRefTemp_degC);

(* Net Differential Axial Expansion Mismatch: Stem expands forward, Cage expands body backward, Ceramic trims tip *)
rNetDifferentialExpansion_mm := rStemElongation_mm - rCageElongation_mm - rCeramicElongation_mm;

(* Hydrostatic Pressure Elastic Compression: Hooke's Law axial strain under 300 bar differential head *)
rHydrostaticDeformation_mm   := (rVotedDownholePress_bar * 100000.0 * 0.0019635) / (205.0E9 * 0.0004908) * 1000.0;

(* Total Dynamic Thermal Expansion Nulling Compensation Offset [mm] *)
rThermalExpansionOffset_mm   := rNetDifferentialExpansion_mm - rHydrostaticDeformation_mm;

(* Estimated instantaneous physical needle-to-seat ceramic orifice clearance [mm] *)
rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm  := rChokeMeasuredPos_mm - rThermalExpansionOffset_mm;
IF rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm < 0.0 THEN
    rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm := 0.0; (* Physical hard seat mechanical stop contact *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MICRO-SEISMIC SLIP ACOUSTIC EMISSION RATE QUENCHING KERNEL
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2nd-Order Digital Butterworth Low-Pass Filter on High-Frequency Acoustic Emission Energy (cutoff = 1.5 Hz) *)
rAEFiltered_dB := (0.0976 * rAcousticEmissionLevel_dB) + (0.1953 * rAERawPrev_dB) + (0.7071 * rAEFiltered_dB);
rAERawPrev_dB  := rAcousticEmissionLevel_dB;

(* Numerical Derivative of Micro-Seismic Slip Event Frequency: d(dN_AE/dt)/dt *)
rEventRateDerivative_epm_s    := (rMicroSeismicEventRate_epm - rMicroSeismicRatePrev_epm) / c_rCycleDt_s;
rMicroSeismicRatePrev_epm     := rMicroSeismicEventRate_epm;
rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm := (0.150 * rMicroSeismicEventRate_epm) + (0.850 * rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm);

(* Dimensionless Reservoir Geomechanical Instability Stress Index (Mohr-Coulomb Proximity) *)
rSeismicStressIndex := (rAEFiltered_dB / rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB) * 0.60 + (rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm / rMaxEventRate_epm) * 0.40;

(* Micro-Seismic Slip Active Quenching Controller *)
IF (rAEFiltered_dB > (rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB * 0.75)) OR (rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm > (rMaxEventRate_epm * 0.70)) THEN
    bSeismicQuenchActive := TRUE;
    (* Proportional-Derivative Quenching Gain: Increases hydraulic backpressure damping *)
    rSeismicQuenchDampingGain := 1.0 + (3.5 * (rAEFiltered_dB - (rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB * 0.75)) / rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB)
                                     + (1.2 * MAX(0.0, rEventRateDerivative_epm_s) / rMaxEventRate_epm);
    IF rSeismicQuenchDampingGain > 6.0 THEN
        rSeismicQuenchDampingGain := 6.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Dynamic Negative Choke Trim: Swiftly back off downhole flow to de-energize pore pressure pulse *)
    rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm := (rSeismicQuenchDampingGain - 1.0) * 4.25; (* Retract choke up to 21.25 mm *)
    tSeismicQuenchDwellTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
ELSE
    tSeismicQuenchDwellTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#45S);
    rSeismicQuenchDampingGain := 1.0;
    IF rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm > 0.0 THEN
        (* Smooth exponential decay of seismic quench offset back to zero *)
        rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm := rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm * 0.965;
        IF rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm < 0.05 THEN
            rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm := 0.0;
            bSeismicQuenchActive    := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        bSeismicQuenchActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rAEFiltered_dB > rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB THEN
    bSeismicAlarmActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.9        := TRUE; (* Bit 9: Micro-Seismic Threshold Exceeded *)
ELSE
    bSeismicAlarmActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SUPERCRITICAL THERMODYNAMICS & HIGH-ENTHALPY FLASH STEAM SEPARATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Reduced Temperature and Pressure for Supercritical Water Enthalpy Polynomial Approximation *)
rReducedTemp_tau      := (c_rCriticalTemp_degC + 273.15) / (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC + 273.15);
rReducedDensity_delta := (rVotedDownholePress_bar / c_rCriticalPres_bar) * (1.0 / (0.85 + (0.15 * rReducedTemp_tau)));

(* IAPWS-IF97 Region 3 Reduced High-Enthalpy Approximation for 450 deg C / 300 bar [kJ/kg] *)
rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg := 3180.0 + (1.85 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - 450.0))
                                   - (0.65 * (rVotedDownholePress_bar - 300.0))
                                   + (0.012 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - 450.0) * (rVotedDownholePress_bar - 300.0));
IF rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg < 2600.0 THEN
    rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg := 2600.0;
ELSIF rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg > 3650.0 THEN
    rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg := 3650.0;
END_IF;

(* Surface Flash Cyclone Separator Equilibrium Thermodynamics *)
(* Saturated Liquid (Brine) and Saturated Vapor Enthalpies at Separator Pressure (25 - 40 bar) *)
rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg := 980.0  + (12.50 * (rFlashSeparatorPress_bar - 25.0));
rSatVaporEnthalpy_kJkg  := 2800.0 - (2.15  * (rFlashSeparatorPress_bar - 25.0));

(* Flash Vapor Quality (Dry Steam Fraction): x = (h_fluid - h_sat_liq) / (h_sat_vap - h_sat_liq) *)
IF (rSatVaporEnthalpy_kJkg > rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg) THEN
    rFlashVaporQuality_x := (rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg - rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg) / (rSatVaporEnthalpy_kJkg - rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg);
    IF rFlashVaporQuality_x > 0.85 THEN
        rFlashVaporQuality_x := 0.85;
    ELSIF rFlashVaporQuality_x < 0.10 THEN
        rFlashVaporQuality_x := 0.10;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rFlashVaporQuality_x := 0.35;
END_IF;

(* Calculated Real-Time Dry Steam Flow Fed to Flash Turbine *)
rCalculatedSteamFlow_kgs := rGeothermalMassFlow_kgs * rFlashVaporQuality_x;
rEstimatedFlashSteam_kgs := rCalculatedSteamFlow_kgs;
rBrineDrainFlow_kgs      := rGeothermalMassFlow_kgs * (1.0 - rFlashVaporQuality_x);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 6: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZER
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble Current Deviation State Vector: x(k) = Measured - Nominal Operating Point *)
aStateVector[1] := rVotedDownholePress_bar    - rTargetDownholePress_bar; (* State 1: Delta P_dh [bar] *)
aStateVector[2] := rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm - 5.0;                      (* State 2: Ceramic gap error [mm] *)
aStateVector[3] := rAEFiltered_dB             - 35.0;                     (* State 3: Micro-seismic AE index [dB] *)
aStateVector[4] := rFlashSeparatorPress_bar   - rTargetFlashPress_bar;    (* State 4: Separator press error [bar] *)
aStateVector[5] := rTurbineSpeed_rpm          - rRatedTurbineSpeed_rpm;   (* State 5: Turbine speed deviation [rpm] *)

(* Reference Vector r(k) is Regulation Target (All zeros for deviation states) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
    aReferenceVector[i] := 0.0;
    aStateError[i]      := aStateVector[i] - aReferenceVector[i];
END_FOR;

(* Compute Unconstrained Gradient Vector: grad_J = B_d^T * Q * (A_d * x(k) - r) + R * Delta u(k-1) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aMpcGradient[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
        (* One-step state prediction contribution *)
        aPredictedState[j] := 0.0;
        FOR k_idx := 1 TO 5 DO
            aPredictedState[j] := aPredictedState[j] + (aMatrix_A[j, k_idx] * aStateVector[k_idx]);
        END_FOR;
        aMpcGradient[i] := aMpcGradient[i] + (aMatrix_B[j, i] * aWeight_Q[j] * aPredictedState[j]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Add input rate damping penalization *)
    aMpcGradient[i] := aMpcGradient[i] + (aWeight_R[i] * aDeltaControlInput[i]);
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Iterations (5 Inner Iterations with Step Size gamma = 0.045) *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 5 DO
    FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
        aOptimizedInput[i] := aControlInputVector[i] - (0.045 * aMpcGradient[i]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Actuator Hard Physical Box Constraints & Slew Limiting *)
    (* Input 1: Downhole Choke Position [0.0 .. 100.0 mm] *)
    IF aOptimizedInput[1] > c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm THEN
        aOptimizedInput[1] := c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm;
    ELSIF aOptimizedInput[1] < c_rMinChokeStroke_mm THEN
        aOptimizedInput[1] := c_rMinChokeStroke_mm;
    END_IF;

    (* Input 2: Surface Flash Steam Bypass Dump Valve [0.0 .. 100.0 %] *)
    IF aOptimizedInput[2] > 100.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[2] := 100.0;
    ELSIF aOptimizedInput[2] < 0.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[2] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Input 3: High-Enthalpy Turbine Steam Governor Valve [0.0 .. 100.0 %] *)
    IF aOptimizedInput[3] > 100.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[3] := 100.0;
    ELSIF aOptimizedInput[3] < 0.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[3] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Store Previous Inputs and Compute Delta u for Next Optimization Cycle *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aDeltaControlInput[i]  := aOptimizedInput[i] - aControlInputVector[i];
    aPrevControlInput[i]   := aControlInputVector[i];
    aControlInputVector[i] := aOptimizedInput[i];
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 7: STEAM TURBINE ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC SPEED GOVERNING & GRID SYNCHRONIZATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Rotational Speed Error [rpm] *)
rSpeedError_rpm       := rRatedTurbineSpeed_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_rpm;
rSpeedDerivative_rpms := (rTurbineSpeed_rpm - rPrevSpeed_rpm) / c_rCycleDt_s;
rPrevSpeed_rpm        := rTurbineSpeed_rpm;

(* Speed Governor PID Integration with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
IF (iState >= 70) AND (iState <= 80) THEN
    rSpeedIntegral_rpm := rSpeedIntegral_rpm + (rSpeedError_rpm * c_rCycleDt_s * 0.085);
    IF rSpeedIntegral_rpm > 45.0 THEN
        rSpeedIntegral_rpm := 45.0;
    ELSIF rSpeedIntegral_rpm < -15.0 THEN
        rSpeedIntegral_rpm := -15.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSpeedIntegral_rpm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Standard 4.0% Droop Speed Governing Formulation *)
rDroopCompensation_pct := (1.0 / 0.04) * (rSpeedError_rpm / rRatedTurbineSpeed_rpm) * 100.0;
rGovernorPidOutput_pct := (0.350 * rSpeedError_rpm) + rSpeedIntegral_rpm - (0.045 * rSpeedDerivative_rpms) + (rDroopCompensation_pct * 0.25);
IF rGovernorPidOutput_pct > 100.0 THEN
    rGovernorPidOutput_pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rGovernorPidOutput_pct < 0.0 THEN
    rGovernorPidOutput_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Grid Synchro-Check Window Evaluation (IEC 60255-127 Compliance) *)
rFreqDiff_Hz  := ABS(rGridFrequency_Hz - ((rTurbineSpeed_rpm / 60.0) * 1.0)); (* 60 Hz 2-pole *)
rVoltDiff_pct := ABS(rGeneratorVoltage_kV - rGridBusVoltage_kV) / MAX(1.0, rGridBusVoltage_kV) * 100.0;
rPhaseDiff_deg := ABS(rGridPhaseAngle_deg);

bSynchroWindowHealthy := (rFreqDiff_Hz <= 0.05) AND (rVoltDiff_pct <= 1.50) AND (rPhaseDiff_deg <= 4.0);
tSynchroDwellTimer(IN := bSynchroWindowHealthy, PT := T#1500MS);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 8: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 SINTERING & CIRCULATION PROCESS PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_OFFLINE: Wellhead shut-in, turbine parked, actuators homed *)
        rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 0.0;
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDumpActive        := FALSE;
        bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Standby Ready *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm       := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND bEStopOk AND (wFaultWord = 0) AND bStartCirculation THEN
            iState := 10; (* Advance to Wellbore Prewarm & Bleed *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_WELLBORE_PREWARM_BLEED: Controlled annular bleed to establish initial thermal gradient *)
        wSystemStatusWord          := 16#0003; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Prewarm Active *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;  (* Bypass open to route initial cold brine to flash separator *)
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;  (* Route drainage straight to injection well *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;    (* Turbine isolated *)

        (* Minor choke cracked open: 2.5 mm to warm stem slowly at 5.0 deg C/min max casing gradient *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := 2.5;
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        tStateStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
        IF (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC >= 250.0) AND tStateStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStateStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Supercritical Discovery Pressurization *)
        ELSIF bAbortCirculation THEN
            tStateStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SUPERCRITICAL_DISCOVERY_PRESSURIZATION: Ramp choke to cross supercritical envelope *)
        wSystemStatusWord          := 16#0007; (* Bit 2: Supercritical Pressurization *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Slew base choke setpoint smoothly toward 15.0 mm at 0.08 mm/s *)
        IF rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm < 15.0 THEN
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + (0.08 * c_rCycleDt_s);
        ELSE
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Confirm crossing into supercritical regime: T > 374 deg C and P > 221 bar *)
        IF (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC >= c_rCriticalTemp_degC) AND (rVotedDownholePress_bar >= c_rCriticalPres_bar) THEN
            tPressureStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
            IF tPressureStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
                tPressureStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 30; (* Advance to Ceramic Thermal Expansion Nulling Calibration *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tPressureStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_CERAMIC_THERMAL_EXPANSION_NULLING_CALIBRATION: Calibrate thermal expansion model vs flow impedance *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#000F; (* Bit 3: Thermal Nulling Calib Active *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;

        (* Hold base stroke steady at 15.0 mm while thermal nodes equilibrate *)
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        tThermalExpansionCalibTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
        IF (ABS(rTempNodeCeramic_degC - rVotedDownholeTemp_degC) <= 12.0) AND tThermalExpansionCalibTimer.Q THEN
            tThermalExpansionCalibTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Thermal balance confirmed, advance to Reservoir Circulation *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_RESERVOIR_CIRCULATION_ESTABLISHED: Ramp mass flow toward production target *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#001F; (* Bit 4: Circulation Established *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Use MPC Optimized Choke Position Output *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm > c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm;
        ELSIF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Check if micro-seismic event rate triggers intermediate quench *)
        IF bSeismicQuenchActive THEN
            iState := 50; (* Divert to Seismic Quenching Active Damping State *)
        ELSIF (rGeothermalMassFlow_kgs >= (rTargetMassFlow_kgs * 0.85)) AND (rFlashSeparatorPress_bar >= 22.0) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Advance to Surface Flash Separator Equilibration *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_MICROSEISMIC_QUENCHING_ACTIVE_DAMPING: Fault slip energy suppression phase *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#003F; (* Bit 5: Seismic Damping Active *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0; (* Keep bypass wide open to absorb wellhead variations *)
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;

        (* Choke throttled back by calculated seismic quench offset *)
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 2.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 2.0; (* Keep minimum bleed alive to prevent downhole freeze *)
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Once acoustic emission level and event rate subside, dwell before resuming *)
        IF (rAEFiltered_dB <= (rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB * 0.55)) AND (rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm <= (rMaxEventRate_epm * 0.50)) THEN
            tQuenchRecoveryTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
            IF tQuenchRecoveryTimer.Q THEN
                tQuenchRecoveryTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 40; (* Return to reservoir circulation established *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tQuenchRecoveryTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_SURFACE_FLASH_SEPARATOR_EQUILIBRATION: Stabilize steam pressure, purge non-condensable gas *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#007F; (* Bit 6: Flash Separator Equilibrated *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Regulate separator pressure to target flash pressure via bypass dump valve *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0 - ((rTargetFlashPress_bar - rFlashSeparatorPress_bar) * 8.5);
        IF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct > 100.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        ELSIF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct < 20.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 20.0;
        END_IF;

        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 85.0 + ((rFlashBrineLevel_pct - 50.0) * 0.80);
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;

        IF (ABS(rFlashSeparatorPress_bar - rTargetFlashPress_bar) <= 1.2) AND
           (rCalculatedSteamFlow_kgs >= 15.0) AND bTurbineSyncEnable THEN
            iState := 70; (* Advance to Turbine Speed Governing & Sync Preparation *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_TURBINE_SPEED_GOVERNING_SYNC_PREPARATION: Run turbine up to 3600 rpm, track frequency & phase *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#00FF; (* Bit 7: Turbine Spinup & Synchro Active *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Slew governor valve from PID speed loop while reducing bypass symmetrically *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := rGovernorPidOutput_pct;
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0 - (rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct * 0.95);
        IF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct < 10.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 10.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for synchronized grid breaker close command *)
        IF tSynchroDwellTimer.Q AND (rTurbineVibration_um <= 38.0) THEN
            bTurbineSynchronized := TRUE;
            bSystemReady         := TRUE;
            iState               := 80; (* Breaker closed, advance to Baseload Grid Synchronized *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_TURBINE_GRID_SYNCHRONIZED_BASELOAD: Baseload power generation under MPC & droop governing *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#01FF; (* Bit 8: Synchronized Baseload Online *)
        bSystemReady         := TRUE;
        bTurbineSynchronized := TRUE;

        (* Coordinated Choke, Bypass, and Governor Control *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Governor valve follows MPC power output + frequency droop *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := aControlInputVector[3] + (rDroopCompensation_pct * 0.35);
        IF rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct > 100.0 THEN
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := 100.0;
        ELSIF rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct < 15.0 THEN
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Bypass valve trims excess steam to maintain flash separator pressure stability *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := aControlInputVector[2];
        IF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct > 40.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 40.0;
        ELSIF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct < 0.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 75.0 + ((rFlashBrineLevel_pct - 50.0) * 0.70);

        (* Handle Seismic Disturbance During Baseload Operation *)
        IF bSeismicQuenchActive THEN
            iState := 50; (* Retract choke to quench slip, let bypass take over steam deficit *)
        ELSIF bAbortCirculation THEN
            iState := 90; (* Ramp down to hot standby *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_RAMP_DOWN_HOT_STANDBY: Orderly unloading of turbine and wellhead shut-in *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#03FF; (* Bit 9: Controlled Unloading *)
        bSystemReady      := FALSE;

        (* Ramp down turbine governor at 2.0 %/s *)
        IF rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct > 0.0 THEN
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct - (2.0 * c_rCycleDt_s);
        ELSE
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := 0.0;
            bTurbineSynchronized    := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Bypass accepts steam during unloading *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;

        (* Ramp down choke actuator at 0.05 mm/s to prevent thermal casing shock *)
        IF rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm > 0.0 THEN
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm - (0.05 * c_rCycleDt_s);
        ELSE
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        IF (rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct <= 0.0) AND (rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm <= 0.0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Returned to standby *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_DEPRESSURIZATION_QUENCH: Trip energy dump and fault lockdown *)
        rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;   (* Force shut downhole choke *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0; (* Full steam blowdown *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;   (* Trip turbine *)
        rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 100.0; (* Flood quench desuperheater *)
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct    := 100.0;
        bEmergencyDumpActive        := TRUE;
        bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F999;

        (* Diagnostic Manual Reset Logic *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStopOk AND NOT bSeismicTripLatch THEN
            wFaultWord           := 0;
            wDegradedModeWord    := 0;
            bEmergencyDumpActive := FALSE;
            iState               := 0; (* Return to standby after affirmative reset *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 9: ANTI-WATER-HAMMER SLEW RATE CLAMPING & DIAGNOSTIC REGISTER PACKING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Enforce strict stroke rate velocity ceiling: |dv/dt| <= 2.5 mm/s to prevent hydraulic fracturing shock *)
rChokeSlewRate_mms := (rCmdChokePosition_mm - rPrevChokeCmd_mm) / c_rCycleDt_s;
IF rChokeSlewRate_mms > c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms THEN
    rCmdChokePosition_mm := rPrevChokeCmd_mm + (c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms * c_rCycleDt_s);
ELSIF rChokeSlewRate_mms < -c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms THEN
    rCmdChokePosition_mm := rPrevChokeCmd_mm - (c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms * c_rCycleDt_s);
END_IF;
rPrevChokeCmd_mm := rCmdChokePosition_mm;

(* Update Active State Telemetry Register *)
iActiveState := iState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
